bullets.text: Full-year companywide CR 87.7; PL CR 86.8, reflecting lower accident frequency partially offset by higher severity and credits; CL CR 87.0; Property CR 107.1 with underwriting loss contributed by storms.
Companywide NPW +8% YOY; Personal Lines NPW +7%; Commercial Lines NPW +11%, with for-hire transportation growth reflecting shipping demand and TNC premiums declining; Property NPW +13%.

Companywide PIFs +11%; personal auto PIFs +11%; special lines PIFs +8%, reflecting outdoor recreation desires; policy life expectancy retention improved consistently, with a portion of the increase believed due to billing leniency.

$1.1B in Apron Relief credits provided to personal auto policyholders; filed rate decreases averaging ~3% across 40+ states (~85% of personal auto premium), providing estimated $800M annualized savings.
Portfolio surpassed $47B with 7.9% total return (fixed income 6.7%, equities 24.3%); paid quarterly $0.10 dividends, plus a $4.50/share ($2.6B) annual dividend declared in December.
Expense ratio was 21.0 pts excluding policyholder credits (+0.5 pts YOY); PL non-acquisition expense ratio -0.3 pts versus 2019; loss adjustment expense ratio also -0.3 pts.

Gallup engagement reached an all-time high; turnover lowest since Great Recession disruptions; created Employee Relief Fund granting $500–$2,500; employees donated >$1M of vacation time to colleagues in need.
Produced more TV and online video than ever; virtually directed 'Work from Home' Superstore campaign; featured Flo, Dr. Rick, Baker Mayfield; partnered with Whole Foods on Turkey Protection Plan.
Record 30 named storms marked 2020 Atlantic hurricane season with 12 contiguous U.S. landfalls (breaking 1916 record of nine); storms contributed to Property underwriting loss (CR 107.1).
BOP was active in 17 agency states and added to BusinessQuote Explorer in Q4; prior photo and video inspection testing ensured timely, accurate claims estimates while working remotely.
